notes: Fixes the icon names printed across the settings screen. The app embeds a cut-down icon font so it works offline, and it carries only the glyphs the app already used. An icon outside that set does not come out blank — it spells its own name, which is why EXPAND_MORE, MEMORY and EXPLICIT appeared as words in yesterday's new settings rows. The new icons are now drawn from the set that is actually embedded: the accordion arrow reuses the chevron and turns when a section opens, the conversation menu is a gear, and hidden photos use a padlock.
